description:
Ethereum mainnet on-chain read: a contract's event logs, filtered by topic and block range. Ethereum mainnet event logs for one contract over the last N blocks (1-100, default 10), optionally filtered by topic0 event signature hash. Takes address, topic0, blocks. Returns the raw eth_getLogs entries.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/eth_mainnet_getlogs. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__eth_mainnet_getlogs
